title: rosa viscaria var. druentica
intro: Rosa viscaria var. druentica, commonly known as Druentia rose, is a type of fragrant rose that belongs to the family Rosaceae. It is prized for its health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestive issues due to its antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa viscaria var. druentica include its use in treating wounds, reducing fever, and acting as a diuretic, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
